params.body:
## What Ilse saw

Beheer > Dealers > Garage Heuten > Werknemers > edit a user: generate a new API access code, click Opslaan. The code was stored (generating writes immediately), but the modal stayed open and nothing was said.

## Why

The modal form chose its save route with `Request::route()->getName() ? 'ownuser.update.modal' : 'user.update.modal'`. A named route always has a name, so every save went to the own-sheet route. Since 15 September that route only accepts users of the own dealer (R P2-2.7), so an administrator on another dealer's sheet got a 403. `user.js` only rendered field errors and swallowed everything else, so the modal simply stayed open. Through delegated access (the logged-in user is of the dealer) the save went through; through Beheer > Dealers it did not.

## What changes

- `settings/dealer/_tabs/user/edit.blade.php`: the form posts to `user.update.modal` on the administrator's dealer sheet and to `ownuser.update.modal` on the own sheet (the same test the list and the controller already use).
- `UserController::update`: the modal path (`from_dealer`) now answers with JSON `{saved, message}`; an exception there is a 500 with `ui.save_failed` instead of a 200 body saying "Caught exception".
- `resources/js/user.js`: on success it re-submits the dealer sheet as before (list refreshed, saved message), or reloads when that form is not on the page; a refusal or server error is reported with `ui.notify` (error tone). No more silent modal.
- Rule R P2-2.11 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/32-p2-mijn-garage.md`, finding `2026-09-16-gebruikersvenster-blijft-open-na-opslaan.md` (opgelost).

## Tests

`UserModalSaveTest` (4 tests): administrator saves another dealer's user via `user.update.modal` with a token posted along and the token survives; a dealer saves an own user via `ownuser.update.modal`; the rendered modal carries the right action per screen plus the generate and delete buttons; the P2-2.7 refusal is JSON with a message.

Run: UserModalSaveTest, UserAuthorizationTest, DelegationTest, DealerAuthorizationTest, CarpassPasswordTest, AlpineExpressionTest, HandlerWiringTest, CompiledViewsTest, RulesCoverageTest, RulesIdentityTest, BuildContractTest, StylesheetSyntaxTest, LanguageParityTest: OK (68 tests, 981 assertions, 1 incomplete). SmokeTest: 261 page tests green (the IntegrationSmokeTest failures in the same filter come from the local seed data, not from this change).

Checked in a headless browser, administrator and delegated: generate, delete and save; the modal closes and the list comes back in both cases.
params.title: User modal closes after saving, also when an API access code was just generated
